title: Leave Policy
content: Employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per year. Unused leave can be carried forward to the next year up to a maximum of 10 days. Employees must apply for leave through the HR portal at least 2 days in advance, except in emergencies.

title: Sick Leave Policy
content: Employees are entitled to 10 sick leave days per year. If sick leave exceeds 3 consecutive days, the employee must submit a medical certificate. Unused sick leave cannot be carried forward to the next year.

title: Work From Home Policy
content: Employees are allowed to work from home up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Employees must remain available during core working hours (10 AM to 4 PM). Work-from-home requests must be submitted through the HR system.

title: Travel Reimbursement Policy
content: Employees traveling for business purposes can claim reimbursement for airfare (economy class), hotel accommodation, local transportation, and meals during travel. All reimbursement claims must be submitted within 7 days of travel completion with valid receipts.

title: Employee Benefits
content: Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits: health insurance coverage, annual performance bonus, provident fund contributions, and paid parental leave. Employees become eligible for benefits after completing 3 months of probation.

title: Working Hours Policy
content: The standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Employees are expected to complete 40 hours per week. Late arrivals exceeding 3 times per month may result in HR review.

title: Code of Conduct
content: Employees must maintain professional behavior at the workplace. Harassment, discrimination, and unethical behavior will result in disciplinary action. Employees must comply with company policies and maintain confidentiality of company data.
